key_insight: An upwind local discontinuous Galerkin method achieves optimal error estimates for Boussinesq velocity, pressure, and temperature, with time-uniform bounds under suitable small-data assumptions.
engineering_relevance: The analysis supports reliable finite element simulation of buoyancy-driven flows and coupled heat transport.
method: Use LDG spatial discretization with upwind treatment of nonlinear convection.
Establish regularity and error bounds using elliptic/parabolic duality and modified Stokes operators.
Apply backward Euler time stepping and derive optimal fully discrete error estimates.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments substantiate the theoretical findings, but the abstract provides no benchmark details or quantitative results.
watch_item: Time-uniform error guarantees require suitable smallness assumptions on the input data.
paper_title: On global error estimates of a local discontinuous Galerkin method of the Boussinesq system of equations
